patterns.prevention:
• Assign a primary and backup coach to each centre at least 2 weeks before launch to establish consistency and prevent single-point-of-failure gaps.

• Conduct weekly coverage audits for the first month of each programme, flagging any coach absences or transitions immediately to state managers.

• Require coaches to confirm their availability for all scheduled sessions 48 hours before delivery, with a mandatory backup identified if unavailable.

• Implement a 90-day stability checkpoint where programmes with more than one coach change are reviewed for root causes and provided additional support or restructuring.
